players.product: PECVD and gas-phase etch systems for DRAM/NAND

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: consolidated Q2 2026 revenue of KRW 123,671,263,690 against KRW 82,064,274,419 in Q2 2025, with operating profit of KRW 26,026,524,304 versus KRW 20,368,092,326; H1 2026 revenue of KRW 220,913,945,721 against KRW 166,560,495,592 and H1 operating profit of KRW 48,227,867,851 versus KRW 36,638,560,291; H1 net income KRW 58,605,500,910. Semiconductor equipment was 98% of revenue and domestic sales 90%
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue KRW 123,671,263,690 (Q2 2025: KRW 82,064,274,419), Q2 operating profit KRW 26,026,524,304; H1 revenue KRW 220,913,945,721, H1 operating profit KRW 48,227,867,851

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog at 30 June 2026 of KRW 206,944 million for semiconductor, display and UVC LED equipment, against cumulative orders of KRW 427,858 million of which KRW 220,914 million had been delivered; the company withholds order dates, delivery dates and quantities to protect customers' investment information
quarterly_data.figure: order backlog KRW 206,944 million (orders KRW 427,858 million, delivered KRW 220,914 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration (undisclosed names): Customer B generated KRW 139,203,942 thousand (63.00% of revenue) and Customer A KRW 69,485,484 thousand (31.50%) in H1 2026, against 54.00% and 36.40% a year earlier. The sales organisation is split into a Samsung business division, an SK Hynix business division and an OED division, and its two Chinese subsidiaries provide customer service to Samsung Electronics in China (Xi'an) and SK Hynix in China (Wuxi). Revenue from China fell to KRW 21,444,757 thousand from KRW 45,882,920 thousand while domestic revenue rose to KRW 199,338,410 thousand from KRW 120,502,432 thousand
quarterly_data.figure: Customer B 63.00% (KRW 139,203,942 thousand), Customer A 31.50% (KRW 69,485,484 thousand); China revenue KRW 21,444,757 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 45,882,920 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Production: 61 semiconductor, display and UVC LED systems were built in H1 2026 at the Yongin and Hwaseong plants against 88 in all of FY2025 and 62 in FY2024, on a clean-room-bound capacity of 45 systems per quarter (180 per year); work-in-process inventory rose to KRW 36,680 million from KRW 27,430 million at end-2025. H1 revenue mix: equipment (PECVD, gas-phase etch, display and UVC LED tools such as Challenger300HTi, Challenger300HTx and CUMAX) KRW 192,919 million (87.3%), parts and service KRW 27,995 million (12.7%)
quarterly_data.figure: 61 systems produced in H1 2026 (FY2025: 88); capacity 45 systems per quarter; equipment KRW 192,919 million (87.3%)

quarterly_data.signal: Product pipeline: under development are an EUV PECVD (Challenger TE) that deposits under-layer ACL beneath EUV metal-oxide resist, a high-productivity quad-chamber SiCN PECVD (TETRA) to replace fully imported tools, a high-density ACL PECVD (CYGNUS) that the company calls Korea's first ICP-type low-temperature ACL deposition, a low-k SiCO spacer PECVD (Aqulla) and a gap-fill ACL PECVD (Pulsar). The gas-phase etcher, launched to a new customer from H2 2016 for DRAM and extended to NAND in 2019, is now also applied in non-memory processes, where the company expects future sales. R&D spending was KRW 24,651 million in H1, 11.2% of revenue
quarterly_data.figure: R&D KRW 24,651 million (11.2% of revenue); EUV PECVD, SiCN, HDACL, low-k and gap-fill ACL tools in development

quarterly_data.signal: Purchases: H1 2026 raw-material purchases of KRW 137,007 million, including platforms (a core equipment component) of KRW 24,704 million (18.0%) from Raontech and others and generators of KRW 16,570 million (12.1%) from AE and others; the average platform price rose to KRW 408 million from KRW 395 million in FY2025. Equipment is 100% built to order and key materials are bought against customer orders. TES holds a 15.0% stake in probe-card maker Korea Instrument (carrying amount KRW 38,287,397 thousand) and sold its whole stake in Raon Robotics (formerly Raontech) in H1
quarterly_data.figure: platforms KRW 24,704 million (18.0% of purchases), generators KRW 16,570 million (12.1%); average platform price KRW 408 million

contracts.signal: Status of the semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contracts with SK Hynix disclosed since August 2025: contracts of 2026-01-02 (KRW 12,094 million) and 2026-01-26 (KRW 19,688 million) are fully supplied and paid; of the 2026-03-10 contract (KRW 19,902 million, to 2026-06-30) KRW 13,883 million has been supplied and collected; of the 2026-03-13 contract (KRW 48,500 million, to 2026-11-04) KRW 29,700 million has been supplied and KRW 14,630 million collected; of the 2026-03-17 contract (KRW 26,500 million, to 2026-08-17) KRW 21,200 million supplied and KRW 7,155 million collected; the 2026-05-21 contract (KRW 21,534 million, to 2027-01-11) and 2026-06-05 contract (KRW 21,200 million, to 2027-01-15) have not yet shipped. Equipment move-in and set-up for these contracts are scheduled from Q3 2026 to Q1 2027, with 90% paid on move-in (FOB) and 10% after set-up; the three 2025 contracts (KRW 20,850 million, KRW 13,500 million and KRW 12,700 million) have been fully delivered
